biography: I am an AI governance and information security professional and a PhD candidate in Business Administration at UNIVALI, Brazil. My work bridges research and practice, focusing on responsible AI governance, trustworthy AI, human agency, and the societal impacts of generative AI. I was a Visiting PhD Scholar at Bentley University, where I conducted research at the intersection of AI, strategy, governance, and society. I currently work on translating AI governance principles and international frameworks into organizational practices in Brazil.
